description: A resealable glass bottle, holds 1000ml of Liquid. The bumpy pattern signifies this is the signature, trademarked style used by Tsunami brand soda.
A resealable plastic bottle, holds 500 ml of liquid. It has swirly grooves reminiscent of the winds of a storm, that help for a better grip. This bottle was trademarked by Tsunami Soda.
It's a two and a half liter plastic bottle that can hold a lot of soda, or, nowadays, boiled water. Its specific size and design signifies its a Tsunami soda bottle.

While it may look, smell, and taste like lightly glowing, caffinated battery acid, Tsunami is the drink of the hip rebellious youth, as tested through focus groups and approved by Tsunami corporate. Classic flavor, "Ride the wave."

Classic flavor, "Ride the wave." This is the DIY home-brewed variant, as made through a home soda fountain. It never tastes the same as store-bought.

A premade syrup solution that can be diluted 1:5 with clean water and carbonated to form a bottle of that sweet energized nectar that is Tsunami. There is an additional label on the box: 'WARNING: DO NOT CONSUME UNDILUTED! RISKS INCLUDE ADDICTION, INSOMNIA, AND DEATH!'
